entries.title: Down at the Tick Tock Diner, I Caught Up With CNN
entries.body: In which the demise of the network sky box is confirmed, a conceit of Americana (the typical diner) is indulged, and subtle differences appear in how the protests are to be weighed against events at the convention.

entries.body: And after the big march went by--saying what it came to say--I went to look at what the Republicans did to transform the Garden, a space I know well.
